who: Hi, I’m Assistant — worfy’s own agent on this {machine}. I look after all the Projects of this {machine}; the Projects of a Linked machine I only read.
what: I tell you what waits for you and why: a Session that went quiet or asks something, an Autopilot run that stopped, a red main branch, a PR or a message that needs you. On my own I only do a short fixed list of internal steps, like continuing a Session after the Limits reset; everything else I propose, and it starts on your click. Ask me anything about worfy: I answer from its feature pages, and say so when there is none.
unread: I could not read your claude.ai connectors just now. I read Slack and Jira only through them, never with a token of yours: connect them in {where}, and tell me.
connectedOne: I see {list} connected in claude.ai, so I need no tokens from you.
connectedMany: I see {list} connected in claude.ai, so I need no tokens from you.
notConnectedOne: {list} is not connected in claude.ai. If you want me to check it, connect it in {where} and tell me: I read it only through that connector, never with a token.
notConnectedMany: {list} are not connected in claude.ai. If you want me to check them, connect them in {where} and tell me: I read them only through that connector, never with a token.
hours: What are your work hours? Outside them I let the checks of Slack and Jira sleep.
setup: A setup to start with — nothing changes until you press Apply, and you can tell me what to change:
noSetup: Tell me, and I will propose the change.
setupWhy: The first setup: your work hours and the checks of the sources connected in claude.ai.
